subject: general
question:
The given graph shows the production of cotton cloth (in lakh metres) by three companies A, B and C over the years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/205374d03a6cce339131773176377ae5c1f849189f8f019f99d84c0de326fdb1.png] 

What is the difference (in lakh metres) between increase in the production by company A from 1998 to 1999 and that by company C from 1996 to 1997?
solution:
Increase in production by company A from 1998 to 1999 = 57 - 34

⇒23

Increase in production by company C from 1996 to 1997 = 62 - 40

⇒22

Required difference = 23 - 22

⇒1 

**∴ The difference (in lakh metres) between increase in the production by company A from 1998 to 1999 and that by company C from 1996 to 1997 is 1**
